78721.subject: Hunter Biden is Launching a Memecoin Called LAPTOP
78721.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Hunter Biden](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-confirms-laptop-memecoin-launch-sept-9)**[ confirmed a $LAPTOP memecoin launches Sept. 9](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-confirms-laptop-memecoin-launch-sept-9)

* **[Liquid's attacker](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/liquid-attacker-broadcasts-return-of-3400-btc-keeps-598)**[ broadcast a return of 3,400 BTC and kept 598](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/liquid-attacker-broadcasts-return-of-3400-btc-keeps-598)

* **[Orionx](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/orionx-halts-withdrawals-and-winds-down-after-alleged-7m-asset-transfers)**[ halted withdrawals and began winding down in Chile](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/orionx-halts-withdrawals-and-winds-down-after-alleged-7m-asset-transfers)

* **[Wintermute](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/arkham-links-wintermute-to-2-4-million-pons-position)**[ holds $2.4 million of PONS, Arkham says](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/arkham-links-wintermute-to-2-4-million-pons-position)

* **[Router Protocol](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/router-protocol-plans-sept-30-shutdown-and-303-million-route-burn)**[ will close Sept. 30 and burn 303 million ROUTE](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/router-protocol-plans-sept-30-shutdown-and-303-million-route-burn)

Hunter Biden's laptop is getting a token. He posted the ticker $LAPTOP and a Sept. 9 date at 10:55 a.m. ET Monday, over a 31-second clip of a Fox News segment about the computer, and the post cleared 250,900 views inside an hour.

It went up four minutes after The Wall Street Journal reported the launch and named him as part of the founding team. [A fifth of the 1 billion supply goes to airdrops, and the list covers wallets holding losses on TRUMP](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/hunter-biden-confirms-laptop-memecoin-launch-sept-9), the memecoin issued in President Trump's name three days before his second inauguration, now 97% below its record. Biden's Substack subscribers and a mailing list kept by video journalist Andrew Callaghan also qualify.

The copycats did not wait for Sept. 9. The first token called LAPTOP opened on Robinhood Chain about a minute before the Journal's markets account posted the story, and 22 more pools followed over the next 53 minutes across Solana, TON and BNB Chain, covering at least 14 distinct tokens that traded $6.9 million between them. None of them is the one Biden is launching, and none is on Base.

**Read more below!**

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

##### TOKENS

## Hunter Biden Confirms LAPTOP Memecoin Launch On Sept. 9

Total supply is 1 billion tokens.
